newsitem.title: USA: GM to consider Delphi/Delco public offering.
newsitem.headline: GM to consider Delphi/Delco public offering.

text.p: General Motors Corp chairman and chief executive officer John Smith said Thursday the automaker is considering a future public offering of its Delphi Automotive Systems and Delco Electronics Corp units.
GM announced plans to combine the two subsidiaries as part of a restructuring involving the sale of the Hughes Electronics Corp defense operations to Raytheon Co.

"Combining these units will facilitate the integration of Delco and certain parts of Delphi into a distinct business unit, giving GM the flexibility to consider some form of public ownership of the resulting entity," Smith said during a press conference announcing the Raytheon deal.
